title: Regret bound for the Hedge algorithm
statement:
Fix $N \ge 1$ experts and $T$ rounds, and let $\ell$ be a valid loss sequence, so that $0 \le \ell_t(i) \le 1$ for every round $t$ and expert $i$. Then for any learning rate $\eta$ with $0 < \eta \le 1$, the regret of the Hedge algorithm satisfies
\[
  R_T(\eta) \;\le\; \frac{\ln N}{\eta} + \frac{\eta\,T}{2}.
\]
replaced:
\textbf{Hedge Regret Bound} (Cesa-Bianchi \& Lugosi, Theorem 2.2).
For any valid loss sequence with $N$ experts, $T$ rounds, and $\eta \in (0,1]$,
\[
  R_T(\eta) \;\le\; \frac{\ln N}{\eta} + \frac{\eta T}{2}.
\]
